brief:
Izzeldeen al-Hayya, the last surviving son of Hamas official Khalil al-Hayya, escaped an Israeli assassination attempt on Friday, Al Jazeera English reported. The strike targeted the younger al-Hayya in Gaza, though details of his whereabouts following the incident remain unclear.

Khalil al-Hayya, a senior Hamas figure, has lost other sons to Israeli operations during the conflict. Izzeldeen's survival marks another instance of Israeli military targeting of Hamas leadership in the enclave.
dek: Hamas leader Khalil al-Hayya's last surviving son Izzeldeen survived an Israeli assassination attempt on Friday.
title: Hamas leader's son survives Israeli strike in Gaza
